## Core Services
- [24/7 Emergency Electrician](https://www.baraelec.com.au/services/emergency-electrician/): Rapid dispatch fault finding and urgent hazard isolation.
- [EV Charger Installation](https://www.baraelec.com.au/ev-charger-installation-melbourne/): Level 2 home & commercial charging station installations for Tesla, BYD, and universal EVs.
- [Switchboard Upgrades](https://www.baraelec.com.au/switchboard-upgrades-melbourne/): Modern RCBO safety switch installations, ceramic fuse removal, and mains capacity upgrades.
- [Renovation & Rewiring](https://www.baraelec.com.au/rewiring-renovation-electrician-melbourne/): Full home rewiring, architectural lighting, and power circuit design.
- [Smart Home Automation](https://www.baraelec.com.au/smart-home-automation-melbourne/): Intelligent lighting, smart switches, voice integration, and automated control.
- [CCTV & Security Systems](https://www.baraelec.com.au/cctv-security-installation-melbourne/): 4K IP security cameras, smart video doorbells, and remote monitoring.
- [TV Wall Mounting](https://www.baraelec.com.au/tv-wall-mounting-melbourne/): Concealed cabling, heavy-duty bracket mounting, and power point relocation.
- [LED Lighting Upgrades](https://www.baraelec.com.au/led-lighting-upgrades-melbourne/): Energy-efficient downlights, ambient dimmers, and outdoor floodlighting.
- [Electrical Safety & Compliance](https://www.baraelec.com.au/electrical-safety-compliance-testing-melbourne/): Rental property safety audits and Certificates of Electrical Safety.

## Help & Fault Diagnostics
- [Safety Switch Keeps Tripping](https://www.baraelec.com.au/help/safety-switch-keeps-tripping/): Safe 5-minute appliance unplug diagnostic protocol and AS/NZS 3000 compliance guide.
